status_verified_desc: Application reviewed and compliant with AuxiNux criteria.
status_compatible_desc: Generally acceptable application, with documented reservations.
status_unreviewed_desc: Application not yet reviewed by AuxiNux.
scripts_warning: This package contains custom scripts: running them requires explicit authorization.
values_intro: The official AuxiPak catalog favors applications that respect the following values. Reviews are performed by the AuxiNux team; they are separate from cryptographic signatures, which only attest a package's origin and integrity.
value_4: Priority to free software, without systematically excluding proprietary software.
values_rule: A publisher can never grant itself the “Verified” status: classification belongs exclusively to the AuxiPak server and its administration. External repositories cannot carry official certification.
docs_client_text: The “auxipak” client is available for Linux (Debian, Ubuntu, AuxiNuxOS, VirtuaOS), Windows and macOS. It verifies index authenticity (TUF) and each package signature before any installation.
docs_install_unix: Linux (Debian, Ubuntu, AuxiNuxOS, VirtuaOS) and macOS
docs_install_unix_text: In a terminal, with an account allowed to use sudo. The script picks the archive for your system and architecture (x86_64 or arm64, Apple Silicon included), verifies its SHA-256 fingerprint, installs auxipak in /usr/local/bin and configures the official repository in /etc/auxipak.
docs_install_builder_unix: To create and submit packages, add auxipak-builder:
docs_install_windows_text: In PowerShell. From an administrator console, AuxiPak is installed for all users (C:\Program Files\AuxiPak); otherwise for the current user (%LOCALAPPDATA%\AuxiPak). The PATH is updated: open a new console after installing.
docs_install_trust: The script prints the fingerprint of root.json (the official repository's root of trust): compare it with the one published by AuxiNux through another channel. Afterwards, "auxipak upgrade" updates AuxiPak itself and your applications.
docs_install_manual_text: The client archives and their SHA-256 fingerprints are also available here:
docs_uninstall_text: Applications installed by AuxiPak are not removed. Add "-s -- --purge" (Linux, macOS) or set $env:AUXIPAK_PURGE = "1" (Windows) to also erase the configuration, registry and cache.
